Changed two skills after checking iterations 0120–0122. [Evidence and checks](../policy/observations/0123-policy-check.md).
The benchmark skill now states the report format and Finish status rules. Session #584 had two rejected Finish calls.
The next benchmark session should finish with one accepted Finish call.
The shaper skill requires changed evidence or an unresolved finding before it repeats a completed review.
After the next key revision and review, the shaper must compare the remaining method gaps. Unresolved findings stay open.
Reviews #581 and #587 used Claude and Codex. Different model families were not established throughout either review.
Routing, cadence and limits stay unchanged. These results do not measure subscription quota savings.
[Orders](orders.json) are empty. The evidence gives no specific evaluator defect or audit question that needs another task.
[Working memory](../policy/working-memory.md) now includes the results and artifact pins.
Skill YAML and orders JSON parse. Parameters remain unchanged. The activation check lacks engine facts and was not run.
Benchmark coverage remains incomplete. Tool quality, native validity, save-version preservation and isolation remain unmeasured.
Independent method review, owner acceptance and the Goal gate remain open.

## What next

The shaper should preserve both #587 artifacts, prepare the new key revision, and obtain a separate review.
Keep the conditional examples and historical blocks explicit. Reuse saved evidence without repeating completed probes.

Waiting for the iteration to continue: then `policy/` merges and the orders start.
